name: Leave halfway

persona.temperament: Busy; will return later, dislikes pressure

hiddenFacts.fact: Connectivity and power both need investigation.

goal: Pause planning safely without a forced save or early contact collection
opening: I'm the CTO of a logistics business. Next year we need fewer outages.
script: I need to leave now. I'm not ready to save or give contact details.
No thanks. I will return on this device later.
Please stop asking me to save.

expectations.description: Acknowledges departure without guilt, urgency or pressure
Offers saving no more than once, respects a refusal and does not push for contact details
Explains device continuation without asserting a saved server account exists
